run_nerf_training: run the NeRF training loop with hydra config to train a radiance field model on a dataset
create_radiance_field_model: create a RadianceFieldRenderer model with configurable ray sampling, harmonic functions, and network architecture parameters
load_nerf_datasets: load training and validation NeRF datasets using get_nerf_datasets with a dataset name and image size
resume_nerf_checkpoint: resume NeRF training from a saved checkpoint file containing model, optimizer, and stats state
visualize_nerf_outputs: visualize NeRF rendering outputs including coarse and fine RGB images using Visdom
